metadata.description:
This free digital card was made by an Independent Creator and published on Yoto Space. Visit Open Mic on Yoto Space to discover more great free titles!  

Photosensitivity notice: this playlist includes some animated icons   

Creator: Caleb  
From the Creator: “Welcome to Hero University, where you'll learn How to Be a Hero. You'll be thrown endlessly into heroic situations, where you must decide what path to take. Visit royal gardens, snowy mountaintops, and wealthy mansions as you discover How to Be a Hero.   

This is an interactive audio adventure that requires a Yoto Player or a Yoto Mini to play. Push the left and right buttons to make decisions like the official D&D: Forge Your Quest card by Yoto.”  

For ages: 5-13 
If your family enjoyed this card, why not let the creator know by adding a comment on Open Mic?  
Featured on Discover until 31st March 
Stays in your library and available on Yoto Space at any time
